newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices little changed.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices little changed.

text.p: NYMEX ACCESS energy prices were little changed in a quiet after-hours market, with most trade focused on squaring positions from the floor session, brokers said.
In overnight trade, heating oil trimmed its 2.01-cent daytime rally by falling 0.14 cents a gallon to 68.70 cents.
An extremely light 62 lots traded overall, with 42 exchanged in the front-month, traders said.
Meanwhile, March crude oil rose five cents a barrel to $24.52 a barrel with trade volume at 229 lots for the nearby contract and 369 overall.

"There's not much to report," a trader said. "We're looking for (crude) to hold firmer than $24," he said, adding it the contract breaks resistance levels of $24.50 and $24.80, it would exceed $25 by week's end.
February gasoline futures eased a paltry 0.03 cents a gallon to 68.20 cents, but trade was nearly dead at two lots exchanged.
